mapper.insert: INSERT INTO borrow_record (book_id, user_id, borrow_date, due_date, status, created_by) VALUES (#{bookId}, #{userId}, #{borrowDate}, #{dueDate}, 0, #{createdBy})
mapper.select: SELECT br.*, b.title as book_title, b.author as book_author FROM borrow_record br LEFT JOIN book b ON br.book_id = b.id WHERE br.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY br.created_date DESC
